origin: Synthetic demonstration only. No real learner, consent, or outcome is represented.

requirements.statement: Practise a polite request and clarification response in Italian

data.condition: In an Italian café exchange after an English instruction
data.performance: Request a drink politely and answer a clarification in Italian
data.criterion: Comprehensible request and suitable answer, with form scored separately

data.provenance: Synthetic response: I want coffee. The learner used English for the target-language task.
Synthetic response after hint 'try vorrei': Vorrei un caffè. The clarification remains unanswered.
Synthetic response after a clarification prompt: Vorrei un caffè, per favore. No, grazie.
Synthetic independent response after session resume: Vorrei dell'acqua, per favore. Naturale, grazie.
Synthetic response: Un tè freddo. It names a drink but omits the required polite request and full exchange.

hypotheses: The learner can produce a polite request with immediate prompting
Independent performance may vary by context and delay
alternatives: The delayed response may reflect attention to the drink noun rather than forgetting vorrei
The target-language instruction may have been misunderstood
data.uncertainty: Five synthetic events across three tasks cannot establish stable competence or cause of the delayed partial response
data.next_probe: Ask for a new polite request and clarification response without a model or hint

priorities: Probe delayed independent use of polite request and second turn
data.conclusions: Observed synthetic transfer success followed by a delayed partial response; reason remains unresolved
data.limits: Demonstration events only, with no real learner and no calibrated confidence

next_tasks: New unassisted café or bakery exchange with a clarification
data.timing: Next available study session; no external reminder promised
data.stop: Stop after the agreed time or repeated failure and offer a different explanation
data.resume: After E3, resume at LANG-I2 with the two hints and all three attempts preserved

measures.name: Unassisted first-attempt correct
measures.interpretation: One correct response across three distinct task first attempts

measures.name: Hint-assisted correct
measures.interpretation: One correct response across two hint-assisted attempts

measures.interpretation: One synthetic transfer task, insufficient to generalize
